text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after going out, Sakura Bakushin O starts to look gloomy again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the day of her freckled classmate's departure draws closer, her mood grows darker and darker.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …I know that Tracen Academy has many students that come and go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But for whatever reason, I believed that everyone in the class would stay together, grow and improve together, and then graduate together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Even so, the day she'll leave us all is really drawing near…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I want to do something for her as class representative during the time she still has left…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It needs to be something memorable! Hmm, what would be best?
choice_data_list: You could run together for fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Running?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time spent together training for her final race ends up becoming a precious experience to Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest they go on one last run together, just for fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh ho! I'd expect nothing less of you! That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That special training wasn't just important to her, it was a precious memory for me too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'll invite her first thing tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Sakura Bakushin O and her freckled classmate meet near the tracks together.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a perfectly cloudless sky! The ideal weather to Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: It actually feels kind of nostalgic. Our special training feels like it was so long ago!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I feel the same. Right, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Don't hold back! Let's both give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'm not gonna lose, Baku!

text_block_list.name: Together
text_block_list.text: Yes! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them race off with smiles brighter than the sun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They continue running for as long as their energy and time permit.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… That was a nice Bakushin from you!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You too, Baku! That was a super fun partner run!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …You know, I'm so grateful to you, Baku. And of course to your trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: This invigorating feeling is all thanks to the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Don't be so modest. I told you once before, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I just did what is expected of me as the class representative!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah… Was that all it was?

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And here I thought we had become good friends…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: N-no! Of course, it was also because you're an important friend to me!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you! ♪ Can we stay friends from here on?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course! No matter how far apart we are, you'll always be my friend!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A song, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume at Tracen Academy share their feelings in the form of races or concert performances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest to Sakura Bakushin O that she let her classmate know how she feels by putting her words into a song and doing a live show.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm also a student of Tracen Academy! What's more, I'm also a genius and class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll compose the best song with the other class members, and put on a live concert she'll never forget!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Sakura Bakushin O and her classmates reserve the gymnasium to put on a live concert.
choice_data_list: Come here, the main act should stand in the middle!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Is this real? A concert just for me?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Yup, yup! We worked hard to prepare everything!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks to everyone, we made a fantastic song! I present you with the best song of encouragement ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Your classmates are ready to start the BAKUSHIN LIVE SHOW!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Eyes forward, and walk toward the future. ♪ Even if we walk a different path. ♪

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's honest and sweet singing voice, combined with her classmates' cheerful clapping, echoes through the vicinity. But before long…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Even though this is goodbye…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At a loss for words, Sakura Bakushin O's eyes fall to the floor.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I…

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: …Our hearts look straightforward, a direct link. ♪ Connecting us below the blue sky. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: E-everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: (What am I doing? Wallowing in sentiment and interrupting the performance…)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: (I have to send her off with a song, as class representative… as myself!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is this goodbye? No! ♪ This is progress! ♪ We move forward into the future!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O manages to compose herself and the concert goes off without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I am really sorry for showing you such an embarrassing side of me earlier.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Thank you for the wonderful performance you put on for me!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …I will continue running even after leaving the academy.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Our parting is just a "Bakushin straight for the future," right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Yes! One day, let's run together again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with this farewell, Sakura Bakushin O grows a little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Cheer her on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as Sakura Bakushin O is saddened by her parting, the freckled girl is sure to be just as sad about moving away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, if this continues, it'll be nothing more than a tearful goodbye. So, I suggest she gives her a cheerful send-off instead.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're right. It's just as you say!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm going to put all my energy into one final cheer to send her off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That way she'll smile each time she thinks back on her time at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the day of parting comes…

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for coming to see me off! You even brought your trainer, Baku!
choice_data_list: All the best at your next place.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! All the best to you two as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to stay together in the same class and graduate together… Sniff.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Baku…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But I made up my mind! I'm going to see you off with a big smile as class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: GO! GO! FIGHT! FULL STEAM AHEAD! SUPER BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: GO! GO! FIGHT! FULL STEAM AHEAD! SUPER BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Along with her classmates, Sakura Bakushin O gives a warm cheer to her departing friend.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm really sad to leave you all, but I'll do my best at my new location!
choice_data_list: Ah, I think that's the sign to board.

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I have to go now. Take care, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As everyone watches the girl hurry toward the boarding gate, Sakura Bakushin O hurriedly chases after her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …H-hold on! Let me say one last thing!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No matter how far apart we are, I will always be your class representative! That alone will never change!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …That's right!

text_block_list.name: Freckled Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I was able to be in the same class as you… and to have you as my class representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her friend is out of sight, Sakura Bakushin O looks at the ground dejectedly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But just as quickly she raises her face and looks at us with an energetic expression once more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's go back, everyone! We have to make sure our fame spreads throughout the country to make up for our missing member!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's aim for a bright future! Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her cheerful voice reverberates around the vicinity, adding a little warmth to the hearts of everyone present.
